lines.name: lusia-hello
lines.text: Hi. I'm Lusia, and this is my friend Basil. Pick a little house and let's play together.

lines.name: lusia-help
lines.text: Look carefully. You can do it.

lines.name: lusia-realm-meadow
lines.text: This is Puzzle Meadow. Pick a little house.

lines.name: lusia-realm-asleep
lines.text: This land is still asleep. Ask a grown-up.

lines.name: lusia-realm-path
lines.text: This is my Path. Here we draw with a finger.

lines.name: lusia-dots
lines.text: Connect the dots in order. Start with number one.

lines.name: lusia-realm-studio
lines.text: This is the Little Studio. Here you can paint and create.

lines.name: lusia-good-night
lines.text: That's enough playing for today. Lusia and Basil are going to sleep. See you tomorrow.

lines.name: lusia-melody

lines.name: lusia-syllables
lines.text: Put the syllables in order, and then we'll read together.

lines.name: lusia-coloring
lines.text: Pick a color and touch the picture. Paint it any way you like.

lines.name: lusia-coloring-done
lines.text: Beautiful. When you are done, touch the green arrow.

lines.name: lusia-stickers
lines.text: Make your own sticker picture. Drag a sticker onto the meadow.

lines.name: lusia-letters
lines.text: Draw the letter with your finger. Start at the green dot.

lines.name: lusia-digits
lines.text: Draw the number with your finger. Start at the green dot.

lines.name: bazyl-oops-2
lines.text: Hmm, that's not it. Try once more.

lines.name: bazyl-reward
lines.text: Well done. You get a new sticker.

lines.name: bazyl-hello
lines.text: Hey. I'm Basil. Come on, it's going to be fun.

lines.name: bazyl-realms
lines.text: Touch the colorful circles at the top to visit other lands.

lines.name: bazyl-stories
lines.text: What happened first? Put the pictures in order.

lines.name: bazyl-history-flower
lines.text: First a seed, then a sprout, and at the end a flower.

lines.name: bazyl-history-chick
lines.text: First an egg, then the shell cracks, and at the end there's a little chick.

lines.name: bazyl-history-butterfly
lines.text: First a caterpillar, then a cocoon, and at the end a butterfly.

lines.name: bazyl-history-snowman
lines.text: First one snowball, then another, and at the end a snowman.

lines.name: bazyl-history-apple
lines.text: First a whole apple, then a bite, and at the end an apple core.

lines.name: bazyl-history-ice-cream
lines.text: First a full ice cream, then less and less, and at the end an empty cone.

lines.name: bazyl-history-froglet
lines.text: First little eggs, then a tadpole, and at the end a frog.

lines.name: bazyl-history-sandwich
lines.text: First the bread, then the butter, and at the end a yummy sandwich.

lines.name: bazyl-history-tower
lines.text: First one block, then two, and at the end a tall tower.

lines.name: bazyl-history-balloon
lines.text: First an empty balloon, then a little air, and at the end a big balloon.

lines.name: bazyl-history-cake
lines.text: First we mix the batter, then we bake, and at the end there is a cake.

lines.name: bazyl-history-castle
lines.text: First a bucket of sand, then a sand tower, and at the end a sandcastle.

lines.name: bazyl-history-egg
lines.text: First an egg, then we crack it into the pan, and at the end a fried egg.

lines.name: bazyl-history-pizza
lines.text: First a ball of dough, then the sauce, and at the end a yummy pizza.

lines.name: bazyl-history-cocoa
lines.text: First an empty mug, then milk, and at the end warm cocoa.

lines.name: bazyl-history-nest
lines.text: First some twigs, then a nest, and at the end a bird in the nest.

lines.name: bazyl-history-small-tree
lines.text: First a tiny sapling, then a little tree, and at the end an apple tree with apples.

lines.name: bazyl-history-day
lines.text: First the sun rises in the morning, then it is daytime, and at the end it is night.

lines.name: bazyl-history-banana
lines.text: First a whole banana, then we peel it, and at the end only the peel is left.

lines.name: bazyl-history-watermelon
lines.text: First a whole watermelon, then we cut it in half, and at the end yummy slices.

lines.name: bazyl-history-aquarium
lines.text: First an empty fish bowl, then water, and at the end a little fish.

lines.name: bazyl-history-gift
lines.text: First a wrapped present, then we open it, and inside there is a teddy bear.

lines.name: bazyl-history-car-wash
lines.text: First a muddy car, then soap foam, and at the end it is shiny and clean.

lines.name: bazyl-history-cupcake
lines.text: First batter in a paper cup, then we bake it, and at the end cream and a cherry.

lines.name: bazyl-realm-workshop
lines.text: Welcome to my workshop. Here we drag and arrange.

lines.name: bazyl-patterns
lines.text: What comes next? Drag the missing picture.

lines.name: bazyl-shapes
lines.text: Put each block into its hole.

lines.name: bazyl-matching
lines.text: What doesn't belong? Touch that picture.

lines.name: bazyl-jigsaw
lines.text: Finish the picture. Drag the pieces into their places.

lines.name: bazyl-drag
lines.text: Hold a picture with your finger and drag it to the box.

lines.name: bazyl-sort-categories
lines.text: Sort them. Each thing goes into its box.

lines.name: bazyl-sort-colors
lines.text: Put each thing into the bucket of the same color.

lines.name: bazyl-sort-houses
lines.text: Where do these animals live? Take each one to its home.

lines.name: bazyl-sort-seasons
lines.text: What do we wear in summer, and what in winter?

lines.name: bazyl-sort-size
lines.text: Which animals are big, and which are small?

lines.name: bazyl-sort-motion
lines.text: How do these things move? Sort them.
